newsitem.title: ROMANIA: SOCCER-STEAUA FANS DETAINED AFTER RIOTS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-STEAUA FANS DETAINED AFTER RIOTS.

text.p: Romanian police said on Thursday that 27 Steaua fans were detained after rioting in Bucharest following their team's 6-2 home victory over Jiul Petrosani.
The incidents happened late on Wednesday when the fans made their way to Bucharest's main stadium where Steaua's arch-rivals Dinamo lost 2-1 to first division leaders FC National.
Police said the Steaua fans had hurled stones at passing cars and attacked city buses, injuring several drivers and passengers.
"Several people have been taken to hospital but their condition is not serious," a police spokesman said.
He said 13 fans had been charged with disturbing the peace.
